scope: Prove the post-Publish-14.1 Halloween city buildouts, including static decorations and generic spawners, have no surviving universe-event admission path.

eraEvidence.core3Boundary: No Halloween or Galactic Moon Festival event, buildout, vendor, skeleton spawner, or universe-event controller exists in the pinned Publish 14.1 Core3 tree.
eraEvidence.areaBoundary: The complete Moenia and Mos Eisley Halloween buildouts are registered with eventRequired=halloween; no row can instantiate while that universe event is absent.
eraEvidence.engineBoundary: ServerBuildoutManager withholds required-event rows when inactive, tracks loaded event objects, and PlanetObject event-list changes invoke onEventStarted/onEventStopped to create or delete them.

runtimeEvidence.reason: This milestone adds no runtime overlay. The owning control-plane milestone already stopped stale Halloween event state and passed the live client/server probe.
